title: Block 1: Re-architect the orchestration state to use a flat adjacency
description: Re-architect the orchestration state to use a flat adjacency array mapping `parentId` to `childId` across the MACRO, MESO, MICRO, and NANO taxonomy. [Acceptance Criteria: `state.ts` exports a flat-tree schema that explicitly replaces nested JSON arrays, validating against the 4-tier taxonomic boundaries.]
